description: Live SLA clock for a support ticket: business minutes elapsed and remaining, breached or not, and the deadline. The clock pauses outside working hours, on weekends and holidays, and during manual pauses (e.g. waiting on customer). Custom hours, workdays, country holidays, DST-aware. Use for support-agent SLA tracking and escalation. First 25 calls per day are free, then $0.001 per call (x402).

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code (207 countries); its public holidays (2000–2050) are excluded from business days

holidays.description: Extra dates excluded from business-day counts (rest days from workdays are always excluded)

now.description: Current time (default: now), same formats as start

pauses.description: Manual pauses (e.g. waiting on customer), up to 100

end.description: ISO 8601 with offset; omit while the pause is ongoing

sla_hours.description: SLA target in business hours (combine with sla_minutes)

start.description: When the SLA clock started: ISO 8601 with offset, or local YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in timezone

timezone.description: IANA time zone of the support team's working hours

workdays.description: Working days of the week, 0 = Sunday. Default [1,2,3,4,5] (Mon–Fri); e.g. [0,1,2,3,4] for Sun–Thu or [1,2,3,4,5,6] for Mon–Sat

name: sla_countdown

resumes_at.description: When the clock restarts, if paused by working hours

title: SLA countdown (business hours)
